title: John the Baptist Prepares the Way

questions.question: In those days, where did John the Baptist come preaching?
options: On the shores of the Sea of Galilee
questions.explanation: Matthew 3:1 (ESV): "In those days John the Baptist came preaching in the wilderness of Judea,"

questions.question: What was John the Baptist's core message?
options: "Repent, for the kingdom of heaven is at hand."
"Believe in the light and be saved."
"Grace and peace to you from God."
questions.correctAnswer: "Repent, for the kingdom of heaven is at hand."
questions.explanation: Matthew 3:2 (ESV): "'Repent, for the kingdom of heaven is at hand.'"

questions.question: John the Baptist fulfilled the words of the prophet Isaiah: "The voice of one crying in the wilderness: Prepare the way of the Lord; make his paths..."
questions.explanation: Matthew 3:3 (ESV): "...The voice of one crying in the wilderness: 'Prepare the way of the Lord; make his paths straight.'"

questions.question: What did John the Baptist wear?
options: A garment of camel's hair and a leather belt around his waist
questions.correctAnswer: A garment of camel's hair and a leather belt around his waist
questions.explanation: Matthew 3:4 (ESV): "Now John wore a garment of camel's hair and a leather belt around his waist,"

questions.question: What was John the Baptist's food?
questions.explanation: Matthew 3:4 (ESV): "and his food was locusts and wild honey."

questions.question: In which river were the people of Jerusalem and Judea baptized by John?
questions.explanation: Matthew 3:6 (ESV): "and they were baptized by him in the river Jordan, confessing their sins."

questions.question: What did people do as they were baptized by John?
questions.explanation: Matthew 3:6 (ESV): "and they were baptized by him in the river Jordan, confessing their sins."

questions.question: What did John call the many Pharisees and Sadducees who came to his baptism?
questions.explanation: Matthew 3:7 (ESV): "But when he saw many of the Pharisees and Sadducees coming to his baptism, he said to them, 'You brood of vipers! Who warned you to flee from the wrath to come?'"

questions.question: What did John tell the Pharisees and Sadducees to bear?
questions.explanation: Matthew 3:8 (ESV): "Bear fruit in keeping with repentance."

questions.question: John warned them against presuming to say "We have Abraham as our father," because God is able to raise up children for Abraham from what?
questions.explanation: Matthew 3:9 (ESV): "And do not presume to say to yourselves, 'We have Abraham as our father,' for I tell you, God is able from these stones to raise up children for Abraham."

questions.question: According to John, where is the axe already laid?
options: At the root of the trees
At the foundation of the temple
At the neck of the wicked
At the gates of the city
questions.correctAnswer: At the root of the trees
questions.explanation: Matthew 3:10 (ESV): "Even now the axe is laid to the root of the trees. Every tree therefore that does not bear good fruit is cut down and thrown into the fire."

questions.question: John said he baptized with water for repentance, but the one who is coming after him is mightier, and will baptize with what?
questions.explanation: Matthew 3:11 (ESV): "He will baptize you with the Holy Spirit and fire."

questions.question: What did John say about his own worthiness compared to the one coming after him?
options: "whose sandals I am not worthy to carry"
questions.correctAnswer: "whose sandals I am not worthy to carry"
questions.explanation: Matthew 3:11 (ESV): "but he who is coming after me is mightier than I, whose sandals I am not worthy to carry."

questions.question: When Jesus came to be baptized, why did John try to prevent Him?
options: John said, "I need to be baptized by you, and do you come to me?"
John knew the water was defiled
John said Jesus was not sinful
questions.correctAnswer: John said, "I need to be baptized by you, and do you come to me?"
questions.explanation: Matthew 3:14 (ESV): "John would have prevented him, saying, 'I need to be baptized by you, and do you come to me?'"

questions.question: What happened exactly when Jesus came up from the water after being baptized?
options: The heavens were opened to him, and he saw the Spirit of God descending like a dove and coming to rest on him
A mighty wind swept across the river
An earthquake shook the banks of the Jordan
Angels appeared and sang a new song
questions.correctAnswer: The heavens were opened to him, and he saw the Spirit of God descending like a dove and coming to rest on him
questions.explanation: Matthew 3:16 (ESV): "And when Jesus was baptized, immediately he went up from the water, and behold, the heavens were opened to him, and he saw the Spirit of God descending like a dove and coming to rest on him;"

key_verse_text: And when Jesus was baptized, immediately he went up from the water, and behold, the heavens were opened to him, and he saw the Spirit of God descending like a dove and coming to rest on him; and behold, a voice from heaven said, "This is my beloved Son, with whom I am well pleased."
